messages:
sophia: FYI compliance flagged long-retention snapshots (>5y) for tenants in cold storage — they want explicit key escrow + auditable restore flow. I spot a few gaps: our key rotation policy rotates CMKs every 90d but archived snapshots reference old CMKs with no escrow metadata. Anyone seen this?

jordan: can you drop an example of the metadata you found?

sophia: pasted sample from bucket: 
```
object: tenant-128/snapshots/2022-03-11-archive.tar.gz
s3-tags: retention=7y, encrypted_by=cmk-archive-v1
metadata: {"backup_agent": "uploader-3.1", "kms_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/cm-archive-v1", "created_by": "backup-service"}
```

liam: oof — we never persisted the CMK fingerprint/version or escrow token with the snapshot metadata, just an ARN string. if the key is rotated/replicated the ARN might still exist but not be usable for restores.

maya: we also don't have lifecycle audit events for object-tag changes in our main audit pipeline. object-lifecycle events get emitted to a separate S3 bucket and that bucket's events aren't forwarded to the audit index.

encops-bot: ALERT: backup-agent v2.9.0 deployed to prod (canary=us-east-1). See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backup-archival

sophia: TL;DR proposed remediation: 1) start persisting CMK key-version + key-fingerprint in snapshot manifest at time-of-write, 2) implement envelope encryption with per-tenant DEKs stored encrypted under CMK and include encrypted-DEK escrow to the compliance KMS escrow store, 3) emit object-lifecycle events (tag add/remove) into audit-index topic, 4) create short-lived KMS grants for restore ops (24h expiry) rather than long-lived roles.

jordan: +1. For the restore flow we should require: evidence path (audit entry), ephemeral grant issuance, proof-of-intent signature from the tenant owner (or compliance) before auto-restore for >1y archives.

liam: quick POC for ephemeral grant creation I sketched — please sanity check: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/cm-archive-v1 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222:role/restore-runner --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextEquals={"tenant":"tenant-128"} --retire-on 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z
```
We'd then store the grant-id in the audit log and retire it after restore completes.

amanda (legal): we need an auditable chain (who requested, who approved, when, and the grant id). If a tenant requests a restore under GDPR/FOUO we also need a retention rationale attached.

ops-restores: operational note — current restore pipeline assumes iam:PassRole to a permanent role. Changing to ephemeral grants will require a small refactor to fetch/attach the grant before running the decrypt step. ETA for patch: 2 days if scoped to restore-runner only.

sophia: action items: 
- liam: add key-fingerprint + encrypted-DEK escrow to snapshot manifest and a migration check for existing snapshots (scope: archive buckets) — ETA 3d
- maya: wire object-lifecycle -> audit-index events, add unit tests to prevent silent drops — ETA 4d
- ops-restores: implement ephemeral-grant flow + add audit recording of grant-id + requester identity — ETA 2d
- amanda: I'll draft the approval template for legal/compliance & retention rationale and post to #compliance — ETA EOD

jordan: low-risk quick mitigations we can enable now: 1) fail fast on restore if manifest missing key-fingerprint, 2) instrument a daily canary restore job that validates a small sample of archived snapshots (decrypt + checksum).

encops-bot: SCHEDULED: canary-restore-job will run nightly at 02:00 UTC; created by ops-restores.

liam: also flagging a vuln triage note — backup-agent uploads include a debug header that contained a partial upload path when earlier running with verbose logs. I filed ISSUE-4571 (sensitive metadata exposure). Short-term: rotate tokens used by uploader and scrub headers on reupload.

sophia: good catch — add to remediation list.

maya: I'll prioritize the audit pipeline fix first so we can prove the chain-of-events for any past restores.

sophia: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short RFC for the manifest change + migration plan. If anyone wants to hop on a 15m later sync ping @sophia. :thumbsup:
